skill.name: excalidraw-diagram-generator
skill.description: Create editable Excalidraw diagrams from natural language, including flowcharts, architecture views, mind maps, data models, sequence diagrams, and business workflows.
skill.summary: Turn structured ideas and processes into editable Excalidraw files with consistent layouts, labels, colors, icons, and connections.
skill.author: github

security_audit.summary: The static scanner findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, diagram metadata, local identifiers, and intended file generation. Two semantic issues remain: unescaped third-party metadata can reach agent-readable Markdown, and icon names can escape the intended library path.

remediation.issue: Untrusted library names are inserted into agent-readable Markdown.
remediation.suggestion: Escape Markdown control characters, restrict icon names, and tell agents to treat generated references as data rather than instructions.

remediation.issue: Raw icon names can resolve outside the library icons directory.
remediation.suggestion: Reject absolute paths and separators, resolve the candidate path, and verify it remains within the expected icons directory.

semantic_findings.title: Indirect Prompt Injection Through Library Metadata
semantic_findings.description: Third-party icon names are copied into generated Markdown without escaping. The skill later directs agents to read that Markdown, allowing hostile metadata to become instructions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The data flow is direct: untrusted library item names enter reference.md, and the documented workflow tells the agent to read and search that file.

semantic_findings.title: Icon Name Can Escape the Library Directory
semantic_findings.description: The icon name is joined into a path without rejecting absolute paths or separators. A crafted value can read another JSON file and copy its elements into output.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Path construction uses the raw command-line icon name and performs no resolved-path containment check before opening the file.

content.user_title: Create Editable Excalidraw Diagrams from Plain Language
content.value_statement: Complex processes and systems are difficult to explain with text alone. This skill converts clear descriptions into editable Excalidraw diagrams and supporting summaries.
actual_capabilities: Generates editable Excalidraw files from natural language descriptions.
Supports flowcharts, mind maps, architecture diagrams, data flows, swimlanes, class diagrams, sequences, and entity relationships.
Applies layout, spacing, color, font, and element-count guidance.
Uses bundled templates for common diagram structures.
Adds library icons and connecting arrows with bundled Python scripts.
Splits Excalidraw library files into individual icon files and a reference index.
limitations: Automatic generation does not detect every element collision.
Complex curves are simplified, and diagrams should usually remain below twenty elements.
Embedded images are not supported by the standard generation workflow.
Third-party icon libraries require separate download, setup, and license review.

use_cases.title: Map Product Workflows
use_cases.description: Create decision flows, onboarding processes, and cross-team swimlanes for planning and review.

use_cases.title: Document Software Architecture
use_cases.description: Visualize services, modules, APIs, data stores, dependencies, and request sequences.

use_cases.title: Explain Data Models
use_cases.description: Generate entity relationships, class structures, and data-flow views for technical documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Flowchart
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Excalidraw flowchart for [process]. Include these steps: [steps]. Show decisions clearly and save a descriptive file.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a short sequential process

prompt_templates.title: Build a Mind Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Excalidraw mind map about [topic]. Use [number] main branches and include these subtopics: [subtopics]. Keep labels concise.
prompt_templates.scenario: Organizing concepts for study or planning

prompt_templates.title: Model a Software System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Excalidraw architecture diagram for [system]. Include [components], labeled connections, data stores, trust boundaries, and a clear left-to-right flow.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Detailed Business Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Excalidraw swimlane diagram for [workflow]. Use lanes for [roles]. Include handoffs, decisions, exceptions, labels, and a final validation summary.

output_examples.input: Create a user registration flow with email verification and an invalid-token branch.
output_examples.output: An editable flowchart with start and completion states, four process steps, one decision, labeled branches, and a concise element summary.

output_examples.input: Diagram an online store data model with customers, orders, products, and order items.
output_examples.output: An entity relationship diagram showing keys, cardinalities, and the junction entity that connects orders with products.

output_examples.input: Show a web request moving through a load balancer, application servers, cache, and database.
output_examples.output: A left-to-right architecture diagram with labeled request paths, component roles, data-store styling, and optional library icons.

best_practices: Provide named elements, relationships, and the desired reading direction.
Keep large systems readable by requesting a high-level diagram before detailed subsystem diagrams.
Review generated labels, paths, and third-party icon metadata before opening or sharing the diagram.
anti_patterns: Do not request a large system without defining scope or priority.
Do not mix process order and data movement without specifying separate views.
Do not use unreviewed third-party icon libraries in sensitive workflows.

faq.question: What file does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates an editable .excalidraw file that opens in Excalidraw or compatible editor extensions.

faq.question: Which diagram types are supported?
faq.answer: It supports flowcharts, relationships, mind maps, architectures, data flows, swimlanes, classes, sequences, and entity relationships.

faq.question: Can it use cloud service icons?
faq.answer: Yes. You must first provide and split a compatible Excalidraw icon library.

faq.question: Does it automatically arrange every diagram?
faq.answer: It applies layout guidance, but complex diagrams can still require manual spacing adjustments.

faq.question: Can I edit the result?
faq.answer: Yes. The output remains a standard Excalidraw file with editable shapes, text, and connections.

faq.question: Does the skill send diagram data online?
faq.answer: The bundled scripts perform local file operations. Opening Excalidraw or downloading third-party libraries can involve external services.
